cohort: 303 pregnant women who delivered at a tertiary care hospital in Odisha, India, between September 1, 2020 and November 30, 2020
finding: There was no significant effect of COVID-19 infection on maternal and fetal outcomes, although there was an increase in Caesarean section, preterm births, and low birth weights in the COVID-19 positive group.
mod_finding: There was an increase in Caesarean section in the COVID-19 positive group.
birth_weight: Low birth weights were more common in the COVID-19 positive group
